close_reason: Duplicate of PKIX-841.20 (already tracked as OID const deduplication, deferred to v0.2).
description: EcdsaP256Verifier::verify_signature declares 'const OID: ObjectIdentifier = new_unwrap("1.2.840.10045.4.3.2")' (line 727-728) and RsaPkcs1v15Sha256Verifier does the same for sha256WithRSAEncryption (line 765-766). Both strings are duplicated from the module-level OID_ECDSA_P256_SHA256 and OID_SHA256_WITH_RSA constants (lines 930-936). The module-level constants are gated on any(feature="p256", feature="rsa"), which is always true when either individual verifier is compiled, so the individual verifiers could reference the module-level constants directly. Duplication risks divergence if an OID string is ever updated. Fix: remove local const OID declarations and reference the module-level constants.
title: OID local consts duplicate module-level OID_* constants
